observation: This port retains the native stochastic elliptic-PDE estimator, including its common per-workitem seed. Complete native outputs are only an interior count and analytic-solution squared-error aggregate. A reduced named grid and path count enable full semantic checks, but agreement is not evidence of sampling independence or convergence. The analytic reference is part of the source contract. There is no pointwise path or estimated field comparison. On the configured fixture the native analytic RMS is0.0345829384; this is an observed aggregate error, not a confidence bound or convergence demonstration.
